subject: hoverPickup
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: militarized pickup converted to hover thrusters.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.

spec.name: Hoverbed Raider
spec.description: A militarized pickup truck converted to ride on four downward-firing hover thrusters, in low-poly cyberpunk style with neon underglow, armor plates and a roof-mounted gun.
spec.layout: A boxy armored pickup floating about 0.35 m above the floor, resting on four hover thruster pods instead of wheels. Front (+Z): angular armored hood with a bull bar, slit headlights glowing cyan and a magenta light bar. Behind the hood is a two-door cab with a sloped windshield (dark glass with neon reflections), a roof rack and a pintle-mounted autocannon on the roof. Rear (-Z): an open cargo bed with a ribbed floor, roll bars, a stack of ammo crates and a rear spoiler. Four thruster pods hang at the corners under the fenders, each a turbine drum with a glowing cyan ring and a downward exhaust cone. Every part is blocky and faceted with chamfered armor panels, olive-grey hull paint with hazard-yellow trim, magenta and cyan neon strips, decals (kanji, stripes, numbers) and glow on lights, thrusters and screens. The lowest points are the thruster nozzles, which rest on y = 0 as hovering feet (the model rests on its thruster feet at floor level). The hull underside floats about 0.55 m up.

parts.builds: Lower hull and frame from the front bumper to the rear bumper: a flat armored floor pan, side skirts with yellow hazard chevron paint, an angular hood with vents and a hood scoop, front bull bar with a magenta light bar, slit cyan headlights (glow), fenders with wheel-arch-style cut-outs above each thruster, rear bumper with tail lights (red glow) and a tow hitch, glowing neon underglow strips (cyan and magenta, glow) under the sills, riveted panelled hull paint (panelled/metal paints) with rust and mud near the bottom, stencilled decals such as unit numbers and kanji via svg textures. Owns the whole body below y 1.2 for z from -2.8 to 2.8 except the bed interior and the thrusters.
parts.attaches: Cab sits on chassisTop and cabFloor; bed on bedFloor; thruster pods hang at the four thruster mounts from the underside.

parts.builds: The armored crew cab from cabFloor up to roofTop, z range -0.55 to 1.3: slanted windshield and side windows with dark glass textured with neon reflection streaks, thick A/B pillars, two doors with handles and armor plates with bolts, side mirrors on stalks with small cyan lights, a roof with hazard stripes, a roof rack with spotlights (glow), an antenna with a magenta tip, a rear window with grille bars, interior glimpse with a glowing cyan dashboard screen and two seat silhouettes, the cab back wall with a gun-port. Also owns the turretRing mount ring base plate on the roof.
parts.attaches: Rests on chassis at cabFloor; bed starts at cabBack; turret sits on turretRing.

parts.builds: The open cargo bed from cabBack to the rear bumper, z range -2.8 to -0.55: a ribbed floor, side walls with armor plating and bolts, tailgate folded up with a magenta stripe and number decal, a roll bar hoop with spot lights, a stack of crates with stencil textures and straps, fuel barrels with hazard labels, a rear spoiler, cargo netting cards, tie-down rings, and a glowing cyan energy cell cube in the middle.
parts.attaches: Sits on chassis at bedFloor; touches cab at cabBack.

parts.builds: Four hover thruster pods at thrusterFL, FR, BL and BR, each a pod hanging from the underside through the fender: a mounting strut and armor shroud, a chunky octagonal turbine drum with a steel intake grille texture, a glowing cyan ring band (glow), vane blades inside, a downward exhaust cone nozzle with a glowing violet and cyan core (glow) and a faint blue heat-glow disc card below, hydraulic pistons and cables up to the chassis, warning decals. The nozzle bottoms rest on y = 0. Each pod rides its own thruster joint.
parts.attaches: Each pod attaches at its thruster mount on the chassis underside, with the joint at the mount.

parts.builds: A roof-mounted remote weapon station at turretRing: a rotating base disc and armored housing on the turretYaw joint, a pitching gun cradle on turretPitch with a twin-barrel autocannon (barrels with perforated shroud, muzzle brakes, glowing orange heat tips), an ammo box with a belt feed, a sensor head with a glowing magenta camera lens and a cyan targeting laser sight, hazard stripe and kanji decals, antenna whip. Must stay within the roof area and not block the windshield.
parts.attaches: Sits on the turretRing mount on the cab roof.

calls.reasoning:
I'm working out the buildThrusters function, using the Ctx type as given by the template without importing it separately, and planning each thruster pod's position and nozzle orientation at its mount point.

Now I'm detailing the geometry layout: a shroud strut connecting to the chassis, an octagonal drum body, a cyan ring band at the rim, and a lathe-shaped exhaust cone narrowing toward the nozzle with glowing core discs for the engine heat effect, plus small vane blades and piston rods around the mount.

Pistons extend outward from the mount to the drum as steel-and-chrome rods, with black cable sweeps curving from drum to chassis and a warning decal plane facing outward on the shroud. I'm setting up a pod() helper function that builds each part at absolute positions tied to bone joints, and creating shared textures (grille, warning, hazard stripe) applied as front-facing planes, with the drum's cylinder geometry wrapping the grille texture once around its radial segments.

Still defining geometry...

Adding shroud armor with chamfered frustum edges, a trim strip, and strut/piston details connecting the drum to the pod.

I'm reconsidering the vane placement since the solid cone would hide them — I need to restructure so there's a visible gap between the drum and nozzle, with a hub-and-blade section exposed at the intake area.

Adding a bottom neon ring, then a heat disc using a radial gradient texture for concentric glowing rings, and finally placing a warning triangle decal on the shroud's outer face positioned using the frustum's mid-width.
